statement_nl: Define k0 := min(k, n-k) and l0 := min(l, n-l). Then [n choose k]_q = [n choose k0]_q and [n choose l]_q = [n choose l0]_q, hence [n choose k]_q / [n choose l]_q = [n choose k0]_q / [n choose l0]_q. In particular, H implies that the reduced quotient [n choose k0]_q / [n choose l0]_q is also a polynomial in q.
